newsitem.title: USA: Puget Sound Power large customer plan okayed.
newsitem.headline: Puget Sound Power large customer plan okayed.

text.p: The Washington Utilities and Transportation Commission (WUTC) approved Puget Sound Power and Light Co's proposal to give its largest customers the option to buy power at market rates, a utility spokeswoman said Thursday.
The plan, filed with the state regulators in May, was initially contingent on Puget's proposed merger with Washington Energy Co, but Puget now says it will implement the program on November 1.
The merger is still under review by the WUTC, which is expected to decide on it at the end of this year or early next year.
"We do have the option to eliminate (the market rate schedule) within a couple of years if the merger is not approved," the Puget spokeswoman noted.
